2014 Arctic Cat Wildcat Trail
$6,300

This is 2014 Arctic Cat Wildcat Trail that is in very good condition. It is great for riding on the trails that are restricted to 50" on the Grand Mesa. Full electronic lockers allow it to crawl over anything. Has an electric winch, rear receiver hitch and aftermarket lights.  Just don't use it enough. Would be great for hunting or just exploring the area.
